Introduction About MPOWER 5% TOPICAL SOLUTION

MPOWER 5% TOPICAL SOLUTION contains Minoxidil which belongs to the group of medicines called Vasodilators. It is used to manage hereditary hair loss (androgenic alopecia) on the head in men and women. MPOWER 5% TOPICAL SOLUTION is used to manage only mild to moderate hair loss problems, not complete hair loss and helps to stimulate hair growth in such cases.

MPOWER 5% TOPICAL SOLUTION is not to be used in cases of the pattern of your hair loss differs from a receding hairline and crown balding, have no family history of hair loss, have total baldness or complete loss of all body hair, have inflamed, infected, irritated or painful scalp, have any condition that affects your scalp such as sunburn and psoriasis and are currently taking other medications that are being applied on the scalp. Consult your doctor for a proper physical examination of the scalp before using this medicine.

MPOWER 5% TOPICAL SOLUTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women or those who are planning to get pregnant, breastfeeding women, children less than 18 years of age as well as elderly individuals over 65 years of age.

The most common side effects of applying MPOWER 5% TOPICAL SOLUTION are headache, itching of the scalp, rash, burning sensation and excessive hair growth. Consult your doctor in case any of the side effects worsen or persist for long.

mechanismOfAction:
How MPOWER 5% TOPICAL SOLUTION Works

MPOWER 5% TOPICAL SOLUTION regrows hair and stabilizes hair loss in men with a receding hairline and head balding by the revitalization of hair follicles. Revitalization of hair follicles is by MPOWER 5% TOPICAL SOLUTION vasodilatory action that helps to increase the blood flow when applied to the scalp. This increased blood flow helps to provide more nutrition and oxygen to the hair follicles thus managing hair cell death and enhancing new hair growth.
usageDetails:
How to use MPOWER 5% TOPICAL SOLUTION

Always use MPOWER 5% TOPICAL SOLUTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. This medicine is for use on the normal healthy scalp only. Apply MPOWER 5% TOPICAL SOLUTION directly on dry scalp and hair. Do not use it on inflamed, infected, irritated or painful scalp skin. Do not apply to any other parts of the body. Avoid contact with your eyes. Your doctor will decide the required dose and duration of MPOWER 5% TOPICAL SOLUTION for you as per your age and disease condition.

Introduction About MELANO TX ULTRA CREAM

MELANO TX ULTRA Cream is a unique combination of Butylene glycol, Glycerin, Kojic acid dipalmitate and Niacinamide as active ingredients used for melasma and hyperpigmentation. MELANO TX ULTRA Cream also evens out the skin by controlling melanin production.

Melasma is a common skin problem that causes dark, discoloured patches on your skin primarily on the face. MELANO TX ULTRA Cream helps to lighten these dark patches by reducing the production of melanin (natural skin pigment). Kojic acid dipalmitate is very effective in reducing the scars but it's important to note that it does not affect the thickness of the scar. It helps in reducing the dark pigmentation which will gradually make it look less noticeable. Niacinamide stimulates collagen and keratin synthesis, which helps in maintaining healthy skin cells by increasing skin elasticity. It helps to lighten dark spots, reduce pore size over time.

Use MELANO TX ULTRA Cream as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Do not use if you are allergic to any of its ingredients. Apply as directed by your doctor.

name: AZTOFA 2% Ointment 15g
introduction:
Introduction About AZTOFA 2% OINTMENT

AZTOFA 2% Ointment is used to manage mild to moderate atopic dermatitis, such as dry, itchy, swollen, and red skin. It contains Tofacitinib, which belongs to the group of medicines called Janus Kinase Inhibitors. It suppresses an overactive immune system by inhibiting certain enzymes called Janus kinases (JAKs). Thus, AZTOFA blocks the production of pro-inflammatory substances (including cytokines) that contribute to the development of inflammation and other symptoms of atopic dermatitis.

Apply AZTOFA Ointment to the affected area as directed by your doctor to get the most benefit. Prior to the initiation of this medicine, your doctor may order blood tests to understand and monitor your existing condition.

AZTOFA Ointment is not recommended for use in pregnant women and breastfeeding women or if you are suffering from active tuberculosis (TB) or severe liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with a history of chronic lung disease or interstitial lung disease due to the increased risk of infections. The safety and efficacy of AZTOFA Ointment in children are not established. Therefore, consult your child’s doctor for advice before using this medicine.

The most common side effects of using AZTOFA Ointment are application site eczema, application site itching, and fever. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

SCINO 5 SCALP SOLUTION is used to manage only mild to moderate hair loss problems, not complete hair loss and helps to stimulate hair growth in such cases.

SCINO 5 SCALP SOLUTION is not to be used in cases of the pattern of your hair loss differs from a receding hairline and crown balding, have no family history of hair loss, have total baldness or complete loss of all body hair, have inflamed, infected, irritated or painful scalp, have any condition that affects your scalp such as sunburn and psoriasis and are currently taking other medications that are being applied on the scalp. Consult your doctor for a proper physical examination of the scalp before using this medicine.

SCINO 5 SCALP SOLUTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women or those who are planning to get pregnant, breastfeeding women, children less than 18 years of age as well as elderly individuals over 65 years of age.

Introduction About TOFATAS OINTMENT

TOFATAS OINTMENT is used to manage mild to moderate atopic dermatitis (AD), such as dry, itchy, swollen, and red skin. It contains Tofacitinib, which belongs to the group of medicines called Janus Kinase Inhibitors. It suppresses an overactive immune system by inhibiting certain enzymes called Janus kinases (JAKs). Thus, TOFATAS OINTMENT blocks the production of pro-inflammatory substances (including cytokines) that contribute to the development of inflammation and other symptoms of atopic dermatitis.

Apply TOFATAS OINTMENT to the affected area as directed by your doctor to get the most benefit. Prior to the initiation of this medicine, your doctor may order blood tests to understand and monitor your existing condition.

TOFATAS OINTMENT is not recommended for use in pregnant women and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using it.

TOFATAS OINTMENT is not recommended for use if you have active tuberculosis (TB) or severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before using it.

TOFATAS OINTMENT should be used with caution in patients with a history of chronic lung disease or in those who develop interstitial lung disease due to the increased risk of infections. Consult your doctor before using it.

The safety and efficacy of TOFATAS OINTMENT in children are not established. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using TOFATAS OINTMENT are application site eczema, application site itching, and fever. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

TOFATAS OINTMENT is used to manage mild to moderate atopic dermatitis (AD), such as dry, itchy, swollen, and red skin. It contains Tofacitinib, which belongs to the group of medicines called Janus Kinase Inhibitors. It suppresses an overactive immune system by inhibiting certain enzymes called Janus kinases (JAKs). Thus, TOFATAS OINTMENT blocks the production of pro-inflammatory substances (including cytokines) that contribute to the development of inflammation and other symptoms of atopic dermatitis.

Apply TOFATAS OINTMENT to the affected area as directed by your doctor to get the most benefit. Prior to the initiation of this medicine, your doctor may order blood tests to understand and monitor your existing condition.

TOFATAS OINTMENT is not recommended for use in pregnant women and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using it.

TOFATAS OINTMENT is not recommended for use if you have active tuberculosis (TB) or severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before using it.

TOFATAS OINTMENT should be used with caution in patients with a history of chronic lung disease or in those who develop interstitial lung disease due to the increased risk of infections. Consult your doctor before using it.

The safety and efficacy of TOFATAS OINTMENT in children are not established. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using TOFATAS OINTMENT are application site eczema, application site itching, and fever. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

The solution contains two key ingredients: Finasteride (0.1%) and Minoxidil (5%). Finasteride acts as a 5-alpha reductase inhibitor, blocking the hormone responsible for hair loss, while Minoxidil is a vasodilator that widens blood vessels to improve blood circulation. If the medication accidentally comes into contact with other areas of the body, it can cause excessive hair growth. If it gets into your eyes, mouth, or broken skin, rinse thoroughly with plenty of water. Consult your doctor if you experience bothersome side effects or if they persist.

To ensure your safety, inform your doctor if you have any heart conditions before using this medication. Also, make sure to tell your doctor about all other medications you are currently taking. How TINFAL 5 F TOPICAL SOLUTION Works

TINFAL 5 F TOPICAL SOLUTION is a topical hair loss management that combines Minoxidil (a vasodilator) and Finasteride (a 5-alpha-reductase inhibitor). This dual-action formula targets the two major causes of androgenetic alopecia (pattern hair loss): reduced blood flow to hair follicles and the harmful effects of dihydrotestosterone (DHT) on hair growth.

It works by stimulating hair follicles, increasing the supply of nutrients and oxygen to the scalp, and blocking DHT production, which helps to slow hair loss and promote regrowth. When applied consistently to the scalp, TINFAL 5 F TOPICAL SOLUTION helps prolong the anagen (growth) phase of hair, resulting in thicker, healthier hair over time.

DHT Blockade by Finasteride:
Finasteride inhibits the enzyme 5-alpha-reductase, which converts testosterone into dihydrotestosterone (DHT).
DHT is a key hormone responsible for shrinking hair follicles in genetically predisposed individuals.
By lowering DHT levels locally at the scalp, finasteride helps to reduce further hair follicle miniaturization, slowing hair loss and supporting regrowth.
Vasodilation by Minoxidil:
Minoxidil acts as a vasodilator, expanding blood vessels in the scalp.
This enhances blood circulation to the hair follicles, increasing oxygen and nutrient delivery.
It also helps reactivate dormant follicles and prolongs the active (anagen) phase of the hair cycle.
Stimulation of Hair Follicles:
The combination of improved blood flow and reduced DHT allows for revitalization of weakened hair follicles.
This promotes thicker, denser hair regrowth, particularly in areas affected by pattern baldness.
Local Action with Minimal Systemic Absorption:
TINFAL 5 F TOPICAL SOLUTION is applied topically, ensuring that its action remains localized to the scalp, with minimal absorption into the bloodstream.
This helps reduce the risk of systemic side effects associated with oral finasteride.
Optimized for Daily Use:
Designed for once or twice daily use, TINFAL 5 F TOPICAL SOLUTION provides a convenient and effective way to manage hair loss.
With regular use, results may be noticeable in 3 to 6 months, with continued improvement over time.

MPOWER 10% TOPICAL SOLUTION is not to be used in cases of the pattern of your hair loss differs from a receding hairline and crown balding, have no family history of hair loss, have total baldness or complete loss of all body hair, have inflamed, infected, irritated or painful scalp, have any condition that affects your scalp such as sunburn and psoriasis and are currently taking other medications that are being applied on the scalp. Introduction About PACROMA XL CREAM

PACROMA XL CREAM is used to manage atopic dermatitis (inflammation of the skin). It is also used to manage signs and symptoms of mild or moderate eczema (e.g. redness and itch) in children aged 3 months to 17 years and adults. PACROMA XL CREAM contains Pimecrolimus which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal immunosuppressant which works in the cells in the skin that cause the inflammation and characteristic redness and itching of eczema.

PACROMA XL CREAM is not recommended for use in other skin conditions and skin affected by an active viral infection such as cold sores (herpes simplex) or chicken pox. Avoid exposure to sunlight while using PACROMA XL CREAM. This medicine is generally not recommended for use among pregnant and breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of using PACROMA XL CREAM are feeling of warmth and burning sensation at the application site, irritation, itching, and reddening of the skin where the cream has been applied and skin infections (folliculitis). Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

Always apply PACROMA XL CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash and dry your hands before applying. BRINTOP F MOIST 5% TOPICAL SOLUTION is a topical hair loss management that combines Minoxidil (a vasodilator) and Finasteride (a 5-alpha-reductase inhibitor). Minoxidil acts as a vasodilator, expanding blood vessels in the scalp.
This enhances blood circulation to the hair follicles, increasing oxygen and nutrient delivery.

The combination of improved blood flow and reduced DHT allows for revitalization of weakened hair follicles.
This promotes thicker, denser hair regrowth, particularly in areas affected by pattern baldness.

BRINTOP F MOIST 5% TOPICAL SOLUTION is applied topically, ensuring that its action remains localized to the scalp, with minimal absorption into the bloodstream.

Designed for once or twice daily use, BRINTOP F MOIST 5% TOPICAL SOLUTION provides a convenient and effective way to manage hair loss.
